purpose: Emphasize total absence or a complete difference.
keywords: express feelings speak politely show respect
まるっきり + negative / different state
Even after the explanation, I understand absolutely nothing.
It is completely different from the photograph.
That is entirely new to me.
formation: まるっきり + negative / different state
restrictions: An emphatic conversational form of まるきり.
mistake: It does not mean a small or partial difference.
